biotools.summary: stGrads is a computational framework designed to quantify spatial gradients of gene expression and cell composition by integrating spatial proximity modeling. It is applicable to both spot-size and bin-size spatial transcriptomic data, revealing local cellular responses in complex tissues.
biotools.name: stGrads (Spatial Transcriptomic Gradients)
